characters.prompt: Create a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE ATLAS, NOT a poster or single portrait. Reference 1 establishes this project's cute blue whale maid pixel-art simplification and proportions; match that unified chibi style but remove any atmospheric glow. Atlas dimensions ideally 1344x1152; aspect 7:6. Each cell proportions 16:32. Three direction ROWS: row 1 front facing viewer; row 2 back facing away (no face visible); row 3 true right-side view. Seven animation COLUMNS: 1 left-foot-forward walking, 2 idle standing feet together, 3 right-foot-forward walking, 4 working at desk arms forward, 5 alternate working arm pose, 6 reading open small book, 7 alternate reading pose. Feet align identically near bottom of every cell, generous transparent gutters, no overlap. 2.5 head tall adult female chibi, wholesome fully clothed. Use crisp chunky pixel art with simplified silhouettes and a limited palette, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, NO GLOW, NO SHADOW, NO OUTLINE GLOW, NO BACKDROP. Truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No text, no labels, no gridlines. All 21 figures fully visible including feet, no cutoffs. This must remain readable when each cell is downsampled to a native 16x32 game frame. Preserve all identity details across directions. The SAME DeepSeek whale maid from reference1: long deep blue/periwinkle hair with pale blue tips, white frilled maid headband, navy dress with white apron, small curled blue whale tail. Keep tail, headdress, face and dress. No rice bowl while walking or working; book only in reading columns.
